entries.question: Opd
entries.answer:

entries.question: Online registration
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select State (Uttar Pradesh) → Select Hospital (KGMU) → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose your Department, Date, and Time Slot → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register using your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site Registration)**
*   If you choose to visit the hospital directly, you must have the **patient's Aadhaar Number** and an **active mobile number**.
*   Visit the registration counter, provide your details, verify via OTP, and pay the ₹50 fee to receive your physical OPD slip.

**Important Notes:**
*   **Pre-booking is strongly recommended** to avoid long wait times.
*   The OPD ticket counter closes at **1:00 PM sharp** (Mon–Fri) and **12:00 PM** (Sat).
*   Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for their specific department.

For further assistance, you may call the KGMU help desk at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

* भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना बेहतर है।

entries.question: BMLS me addmission kaise hota hai
entries.answer:
BMLS (Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science) mein admission ke liye KGMU ki prakriya aam taur par entrance examination ke madhyam se hoti hai. Admission se sambandhit mukhya baatein niche di gayi hain:

1. **Official Website Check Karein:** Admission ki sabhi update, eligibility (yogyata), aur form nikalne ki dates aapko KGMU ki official website **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)** par "Courses/Admission" section mein milengi.
2. **Entrance Exam:** KGMU paramedical courses ke liye alag se entrance test conduct karvata hai. Aapko us exam ke liye apply karna hoga.
3. **Eligibility:** Aam taur par is course ke liye 12th pass hona zaruri hai (Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology/Biotechnology ke saath).
4. **Notice Board:** Naye admission notifications ke liye aap [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) ko regular check karte rahein.

Jab bhi admission form niklega, aapko website par online apply karna hoga. Admission se judi kisi bhi adhik jankari ke liye aap website par diye gaye "Admission Guidelines" ko padh sakte hain.

entries.question: How to book appointment
entries.answer:
You can book an appointment at KGMU through the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Login/Register → Select State (Uttar Pradesh) → Select Hospital (KGMU) → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose Department, Date, and Time Slot → Enter patient details → Pay ₹50 online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"Appointment [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation via SMS.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   Visit the registration counter at KGMU with the patient's **Aadhaar Number** and an active mobile number.
*   You will receive an OTP on your mobile.
*   After verification, pay the ₹50 fee at the counter to collect your physical OPD slip.

**Important Notes:**
*   **Pre-booking is strongly recommended** to avoid long wait times.
*   **OPD Timings:** Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–1:00 PM | Sat 9:00 AM–12:00 PM | Closed Sundays.
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please ensure you bring a valid referral for your specific department.
*   **Help Line:** If you face issues, you can call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.
